reviews.comment:
La mejor estacion de servicio de Cipolletti. Los muchachos de playa te atienden de forma excelente al igual que en el shop. Tambien se encuentra en la estacion, el Boxes donde podes hacer el service dem vehiculo y una oficina ACA de atencion al socio/a. Justo cruzando la calle, en frente tenes el Motel Restaurante tambien del ACA donde se come delicioso!

(Translated by Google)
The best gas station in Cipolletti. The attendants provide excellent service, as does the staff in the convenience store. The station also houses a service bay where you can get your vehicle serviced and an ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) office for member services. Just across the street is the ACA's Motel Restaurant, where the food is delicious!
